# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Phase Two: Candidate Critique and Risk Graph

> The Awtsmoos keeps the proven release untouched while every experimental edge is named;
> Awtsmoos.com refuses to call a smaller bundle faster until the living browser has proclaimed.

## Critical Risks

1. `createMinimalMeadowRuntime.js` reopens the deferred essential scheduler boundary that previously timed out in production.
2. The local compact bundle is smaller than production, but smaller bytes alone do not prove faster readiness.
3. `MinimalSharedMeadowReadinessFlow.js` now begins full readiness inline; an unresolved full receipt could delay its returned promise even after the veil disappears.
4. Bootstrap minimap imports `WorldMinimap.js` during essential play and may compete with the scheduler request.
5. Rich UI creates a new inventory store and equipment runtime, so bootstrap-to-rich ownership must preserve state.
6. Optional chat quiet windows may improve frame stability while reducing perceived responsiveness.
7. Local-tab chat bypasses the delay and therefore needs separate two-page proof.
8. The generated bundle may have been produced from a source state different from the current files.
9. Existing local Android-emulator work must remain outside every Mitzvah World action.
10. The active production release remains the rollback truth.

## Twenty Improvements to the Audit

1. Hash every candidate source before tests.
2. Record modification timestamps.
3. Compare local bundle hash with public release hash.
4. Verify source markers inside the local compact artifact.
5. Run the native boot contract.
6. Run readiness settlement tests.
7. Run route-shell tests.
8. Run scheduler tests.
9. Run minimap-specific tests if present.
10. Run CompactJS syntax and runtime graph tests.
11. Start a local isolated server from the current working tree.
12. Disable browser cache.
13. Record time to first document response.
14. Record time to diagnostics publication.
15. Record time to essential ready.
16. Record time to playable.
17. Record failed requests and console exceptions.
18. Verify all six systems.
19. Verify movement.
20. Verify minimap ownership before and after rich UI.
21. Verify local-tab multiplayer across two pages.
22. Verify chat imports independently.
23. Compare request count and transferred bytes with production.
24. Reject deployment unless the candidate beats or matches production without new errors.
25. Preserve every uncommitted file exactly unless an explicit repair is later authorized.

## Phase-Two Decision

Continue as a read-only candidate audit. No source writes, compact regeneration, staging, commit, or deployment are authorized yet.
